svg.aria-label: Strategy · RMD and Roth conversion wireframe
svg.title: Strategy · RMD and Roth conversion wireframe
svg.text: PLANS / PLAN FOR RETIREMENT / STRATEGY / WITHDRAWALS
The RMD is withdrawn before any discretionary drawdown in that year.
Distributions follow the selected schedule for every inherited account.
Tax impact lands in the conversion year.
Owners before RMD age show $0 and no RMD line.
RMD is computed from the applicable life-expectancy factor and is mandatory once the owner reaches RMD age.
A manual conversion raises taxable income in the conversion year and moves the same amount into the Roth balance.
The effect cards are the API's baseline and modified values, so the tax delta and the balance delta always agree.
Strategy-driven conversions ship later. This form is manual only, with an optional bracket ceiling.
